messages:
sara_support: Customer redeemed promo via partner checkout. UI shows green check and confirmation email with grant_id G-98765 and claim_id c-12f34, but org org_54321 balance is still 0.0. Customer is blocked from using trial credits. Can billing team investigate?

kevin_billing: Thanks Sara. Can you paste the webhook payload or any partner IDs? Also which customer email/tenant?

sara_support: Partner payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "partner_tenant_id": "p-99",
  "claim_id": "c-12f34",
  "grant_id": "G-98765",
  "amount_credits": 10000,
  "currency": "credits",
  "email": "acct+trial@example.com"
}
```
Customer org: org_54321, billing profile: bp-777. Webhook endpoint returned 200 to partner. Email confirmation sent at 2023-11-12T15:02:10Z.

billing_bot: Partner webhook delivered to /api/v1/promos/webhook at 2318000001 -> 200 OK. Enqueued ledger_job jw-777 for processing.

kevin_billing: I grepped the ledger-worker logs for jw-777 — looks like the write attempted but was skipped: 
```
INFO  ledger-worker - job jw-777 dequeued
ERROR ledger - write skipped: tenant mapping missing for partner_tenant_id p-99 -> no internal org mapping found
```
That suggests the partner tenant mapping service didn't return org_54321 (maybe partner used a different mapping key).

jordan_engineer: I'm taking this. Creating incident INC-2318 to track. Quick repro: simulate partner webhook with the same payload -> ledger worker returns skip due to mapping service returning 404 for p-99. Suspect a partner onboarding metadata mismatch.

kevin_billing: Workaround for immediate customer unblock: we can apply the credit manually via ops command. Command (ops-only):
```bash
redwoodcli credit apply --org org_54321 --amount 10000 --reason "promo grant G-98765 manual apply (webhook mapping miss)" --audit-note "INC-2318"
```
This will create txn id and update balance; needs approval from billing lead.

sara_support: Customer accepted manual apply if we can provide txn proof. Proceeding to get approval.

jordan_engineer: I applied manual credit after approval. Generated txn_id tx-9001. DB update executed and balance moved to 10000 credits. Quick check:
```sql
SELECT balance FROM org_balances WHERE org_id='org_54321';
-- returns 10000
```
Logged audit entry linking tx-9001 -> G-98765.

support_bot: Customer screenshot received confirming balance now shows 10,000 credits. Customer thanks the team. :tada:

kevin_billing: Please add a follow-up action: update partner-tenant mapping for p-99 -> org_54321 in partner-mapping service, add automated retry for skipped ledger jobs (or dead-letter queue alert). Filing follow-up task TASK-2319.

sara_support: I'll update the customer thread and close the support case after verifying no further issues. Thanks all.

jordan_engineer: Closing INC-2318 after root cause fix deployed to mapping service (hotfix) and manual credit applied. Recommend retro with partner ops to prevent recurrence.

sara_support: Case closed with customer; leaving notes and screenshots in the ticket.
